mitigation_measures: Explicitly set the config flag require_explicit_package_overrides_for_builtin_materializations to True in dbt_project.yml for all your dbt projects.
Ensure dbt-core versions are actively updated to the latest versions as these fixes become available.
Review dbt package usage in your organisation.
Ensure software dependencies are being scanned for known vulnerabilities.
Review and minimise permissions that dbt is run with for human and unattended workloads.
Review the controls you have in place in your infrastructure that prevent transfer of data outside your organisational boundaries.
